attchmntText: STL Global Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: STL Global Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting held on November 14, 2026. The company reported a loss after tax of 26.94 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and a loss after tax of 151.51 lakhs for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations stood at 2,392.74 lakhs for the quarter and 4,423.83 lakhs for the half-year. Basic earnings per share was negative 0.10 for the quarter and negative 0.56 for the half-year. The statutory auditors, M.M. Goyal & Company, issued a limited review report stating that nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements in the financial results.
